attempts.prompt:
# Conceptual model description:
## Description
This model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.

### Components

#### Data types
- **Date**
  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)
- **Time**
  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)

#### Enumerations
- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`
- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`
- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`
- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`
- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`
- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`
- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`
- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`

#### Classes (with attributes)

- **Restaurant**
  - `name : String`

- **Reservation** *(abstract)*
  - `time : Time`
  - `date : Date`
  - `numberPeople : Integer`
  - `name : String`
  - `phoneNumber : String`
  - `number : Integer`

- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*
  - `seating : SeatingPreference`
  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`

- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*
  - `groupName : String`
  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`
  - `busService : Boolean`

- **Table**
  - `number : Integer`
  - `description : String`
  - `capacity : Integer`

- **ItemOrder**
  - `time : Time`

- **MenuItem**
  - `description : String`
  - `prepTime : Real`
  - `classification : ItemType`

- **FoodItem**
  - `number : Integer`
  - `description : String`
  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`
  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`

- **Allergen**
  - `type : AllergenType`

- **Person**
  - `name : String`

- **Owner** *(extends Person)*
  - `percentageShares : Integer`

- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*
  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`

- **DietaryRequirement**
  - `diet : Diet`
  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)

- **ReportedAllergy**
  - `allergen : AllergenType`
  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)

- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*
  - `dateOfBirth : Date`
  - `phoneNumber : String`

- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*
- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*
  - `spokenLanguage : Language`
- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*
- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*
  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`
- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*
- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*
  - `driverLicenseNr : String`

---

## Relationships
For each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).

1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`
   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.
   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.

2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`
   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.
   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.

3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`
   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.
   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.

4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)
   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.
   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.

5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`
   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.
   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.

6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)
   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.
   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.

7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`
   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.
   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.

8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)
   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).
   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.

9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)
   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.

# Conceptual model description:
## Description
This model describes a restaurant domain with people (owners, customers, workers), reservations (individual and banquet), tables, ordering, and menu composition (menu items built from food items with allergens). It also includes staff structure (head waiter/waiters, cooks/chefs) and a few business rules as invariants.

### Components

#### Data types
- **Date**
  - Operation: `Date(date : String)` (constructs a Date from a String)
- **Time**
  - Operation: `Time(time : String)` (constructs a Time from a String)

#### Enumerations
- **SeatingPreference**: `Inside`, `Patio`
- **SmokingPreference**: `Smoking`, `NonSmoking`
- **PaymentMethod**: `Cash`, `CreditCard`
- **ItemType**: `Apetizer`, `Main`, `Dessert`, `Beverage`
- **UnitOfMeasure**: `Ounce`, `Sheet`, `Pound`, `Gram`, `Dozen`
- **AllergenType**: `Lactose`, `Seafood`, `Nuts`, `Gluten`
- **Diet**: `Vegetarian`, `Vegan`, `Kosher`, `Halal`
- **Language**: `English`, `Spanish`, `German`, `Italian`

#### Classes (with attributes)

- **Restaurant**
  - `name : String`

- **Reservation** *(abstract)*
  - `time : Time`
  - `date : Date`
  - `numberPeople : Integer`
  - `name : String`
  - `phoneNumber : String`
  - `number : Integer`

- **Individual** *(extends Reservation)*
  - `seating : SeatingPreference`
  - `smoking : SmokingPreference`

- **Banquet** *(extends Reservation)*
  - `groupName : String`
  - `paymentMethod : PaymentMethod`
  - `busService : Boolean`

- **Table**
  - `number : Integer`
  - `description : String`
  - `capacity : Integer`

- **ItemOrder**
  - `time : Time`

- **MenuItem**
  - `description : String`
  - `prepTime : Real`
  - `classification : ItemType`

- **FoodItem**
  - `number : Integer`
  - `description : String`
  - `purchaseFlag : Boolean`
  - `unit : UnitOfMeasure`

- **Allergen**
  - `type : AllergenType`

- **Person**
  - `name : String`

- **Owner** *(extends Person)*
  - `percentageShares : Integer`

- **RegularCustomer** *(extends Person)*
  - `prefferedLanguage : Language`

- **DietaryRequirement**
  - `diet : Diet`
  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)

- **ReportedAllergy**
  - `allergen : AllergenType`
  - (Note: no associations connect this class in the given diagram.)

- **Worker** *(abstract, extends Person)*
  - `dateOfBirth : Date`
  - `phoneNumber : String`

- **HeadWaiter** *(extends Worker)*
- **Waiter** *(extends Worker)*
  - `spokenLanguage : Language`
- **Manager** *(extends Worker)*
- **Cook** *(extends Worker)*
  - `yearsOfExperience : Integer`
- **Chef** *(extends Worker)*
- **BusDriver** *(extends Worker)*
  - `driverLicenseNr : String`

---

## Relationships
For each association, multiplicities are stated at both ends (how many instances at that end can be linked to one instance at the opposite end).

1. **RestaurantOwner**: `Restaurant [1..*]` ↔ `Owner [1..*]`
   - For **one Owner**: owns **1..*** Restaurants.
   - For **one Restaurant**: has **1..*** Owners.

2. **RestaurantReservation**: `Restaurant [0..1]` ↔ `Reservation [0..*]`
   - For **one Reservation**: belongs to **0..1** Restaurant.
   - For **one Restaurant**: has **0..*** Reservations.

3. **ReservationCustomer**: `Reservation [0..*]` ↔ `RegularCustomer [0..1]`
   - For **one Reservation**: linked to **0..1** RegularCustomer.
   - For **one RegularCustomer**: linked to **0..*** Reservations.

4. **ReservationWaiter**: `Reservation [*]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `servedBy`)
   - For **one Reservation**: `servedBy` **1..*** Waiters.
   - For **one Waiter**: serves **0..*** Reservations.

5. **BanquetBusDriver**: `Banquet [1]` ↔ `BusDriver [0..*]`
   - For **one Banquet**: has **0..*** BusDrivers.
   - For **one BusDriver**: assigned to **exactly 1** Banquet.

6. **ReservationTable**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `Table [1..*]` (role on Table end: `assignedTo`)
   - For **one Reservation**: `assignedTo` **1..*** Tables.
   - For **one Table**: assigned to **exactly 1** Reservation.

7. **ReservationItemOrdered**: `Reservation [1]` ↔ `ItemOrder [0..*]`
   - For **one Reservation**: has **0..*** ItemOrders.
   - For **one ItemOrder**: belongs to **exactly 1** Reservation.

8. **ItemOrderMenuItem**: `ItemOrder [*]` ↔ `MenuItem [1]` (role on MenuItem end: `item`)
   - For **one ItemOrder**: refers to **exactly 1** MenuItem (`item`).
   - For **one MenuItem**: appears in **0..*** ItemOrders.

9. **MenuItemFoodItem**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `FoodItem [*]` (roles: MenuItem `isUtilized`, FoodItem `utilizes`)
   - For **one MenuItem**: uses **0..*** FoodItems.
   - For **one FoodItem**: used by **0..*** MenuItems.

10. **FoodItemAllergen**: `FoodItem [*]` ↔ `Allergen [*]` (role on Allergen end: `contains`)
   - For **one FoodItem**: `contains` **0..*** Allergens.
   - For **one Allergen**: can be contained in **0..*** FoodItems.

11. **MenuItemChef**: `MenuItem [*]` ↔ `Chef [1]` (roles: MenuItem `designs`, Chef `designedBy`)
   - For **one MenuItem**: `designedBy` **exactly 1** Chef.
   - For **one Chef**: `designs` **0..*** MenuItems.

12. **ChefCook**: `Chef [1]` ↔ `Cook [1..*]` (roles: Chef `underSupervisionOf`, Cook `supervises`)
   - For **one Chef**: `underSupervisionOf` **exactly 1** Cook.
   - For **one Cook**: `supervises` **1..*** Chefs.

13. **HeadWaiterWaiter**: `HeadWaiter [1]` ↔ `Waiter [1..*]` (role on Waiter end: `responsibleFor`)
   - For **one Waiter**: has **exactly 1** HeadWaiter.
   - For **one HeadWaiter**: `responsibleFor` **1..*** Waiters.

---

## Invariants
1. **Table capacity must be positive**
   - Context: `Table`
   - `self.capacity > 0`

2. **Cook experience must be non-negative**
   - Context: `Cook`
   - `self.yearsOfExperience >= 0`

3. **Restaurant owner shares must sum to 100**
   - Context: `Restaurant`
   - Sum of `percentageShares` across all associated owners equals 100:
   - `self.owner->collect(o | o.percentageShares)->sum() = 100`
   - (Interprets `self.owner` as the set of Owners linked via **RestaurantOwner**.)

4. **Assigned tables must cover the reservation party size**
   - Context: `Reservation`
   - Total capacity of all tables assigned to the reservation must be at least `numberPeople`:
   - `self.assignedTo->collect(t | t.capacity)->sum() >= self.numberPeople`

# Category: Overconstraint Detection
Create an instance that represents a real-life scenario that is logically valid but violates the model's multiplicities or constraints, exposing overly restrictive or unrealistic restrictions.

## Description
This model defines a simple state machine structure. A `StateMachine` (named) *contains* `State` and `Transition` elements (also named). Transitions are triggered by exactly one `TimeEvent` that specifies a positive time value. States are connected via transitions through source/target relationships, and a state machine may designate one start state.

### Components
- **`NamedElement` (abstract)**
  - `name : String` — common identifier for all named elements.

- **`State` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents a state.

- **`StateMachine` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents the container/owner of states and transitions.

- **`Transition` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents a directed connection between states.

- **`TimeEvent`**
  - `time : Integer` — time value used by a transition’s timer.

## Relationships
### 1) `StateMachineContainsStates` (composition)
- **StateMachine end:** `1`
  - Each `State` is owned by exactly **1** `StateMachine`.
- **State end:** `0..*` (role `containsStates`)
  - A `StateMachine` may contain **0 to many** `State` instances.

### 2) `StateMachineStartsStates` (association)
- **StateMachine end:** `0..1` (role `isStartStateOf`)
  - A `State` can be the start state of **at most 1** `StateMachine` (or none).
- **State end:** `1` (role `start`)
  - A `StateMachine` has **exactly 1** start `State`.

### 3) `StateMachineContainsTransitions` (composition)
- **StateMachine end:** `1`
  - Each `Transition` is owned by exactly **1** `StateMachine`.
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `containsTransitions`)
  - A `StateMachine` may contain **0 to many** `Transition` instances.

### 4) `TransitionContainsEvents` (composition)
- **Transition end:** `1`
  - Each `TimeEvent` is owned by exactly **1** `Transition`.
- **TimeEvent end:** `1` (role `timer`)
  - Each `Transition` has **exactly 1** `TimeEvent` timer.

### 5) `StateTransition` (association: State → outgoing Transitions)
- **State end:** `1` (role `source`)
  - Each `Transition` has exactly **1** source `State`.
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `outgoing`)
  - A `State` can have **0 to many** outgoing `Transition` instances.

### 6) `TransitionState` (association: Transitions → target State)
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `incoming`)
  - A `State` can have **0 to many** incoming `Transition` instances.
- **State end:** `1` (role `target`)
  - Each `Transition` has exactly **1** target `State`.

## Invariants
1. **`TimeEvent::TimeIsPositive`**
   - `self.time > 0`
   - Every `TimeEvent.time` must be strictly positive.

2. **`StateMachine::FirstCharLowerCase`**
   - `self.containsStates->forAll(s | s.name.at(1) = s.name.at(1).toLowerCase())`
   - For every `State` contained in a `StateMachine`, the **first character** of the state’s `name` must be lowercase.

# Conceptual model description:
## Description
This model defines a simple state machine structure. A `StateMachine` (named) *contains* `State` and `Transition` elements (also named). Transitions are triggered by exactly one `TimeEvent` that specifies a positive time value. States are connected via transitions through source/target relationships, and a state machine may designate one start state.

### Components
- **`NamedElement` (abstract)**
  - `name : String` — common identifier for all named elements.

- **`State` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents a state.

- **`StateMachine` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents the container/owner of states and transitions.

- **`Transition` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents a directed connection between states.

- **`TimeEvent`**
  - `time : Integer` — time value used by a transition’s timer.

## Relationships
### 1) `StateMachineContainsStates` (composition)
- **StateMachine end:** `1`
  - Each `State` is owned by exactly **1** `StateMachine`.
- **State end:** `0..*` (role `containsStates`)
  - A `StateMachine` may contain **0 to many** `State` instances.

### 2) `StateMachineStartsStates` (association)
- **StateMachine end:** `0..1` (role `isStartStateOf`)
  - A `State` can be the start state of **at most 1** `StateMachine` (or none).
- **State end:** `1` (role `start`)
  - A `StateMachine` has **exactly 1** start `State`.

### 3) `StateMachineContainsTransitions` (composition)
- **StateMachine end:** `1`
  - Each `Transition` is owned by exactly **1** `StateMachine`.
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `containsTransitions`)
  - A `StateMachine` may contain **0 to many** `Transition` instances.

### 4) `TransitionContainsEvents` (composition)
- **Transition end:** `1`
  - Each `TimeEvent` is owned by exactly **1** `Transition`.
- **TimeEvent end:** `1` (role `timer`)
  - Each `Transition` has **exactly 1** `TimeEvent` timer.

### 5) `StateTransition` (association: State → outgoing Transitions)
- **State end:** `1` (role `source`)
  - Each `Transition` has exactly **1** source `State`.
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `outgoing`)
  - A `State` can have **0 to many** outgoing `Transition` instances.

### 6) `TransitionState` (association: Transitions → target State)
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `incoming`)
  - A `State` can have **0 to many** incoming `Transition` instances.
- **State end:** `1` (role `target`)
  - Each `Transition` has exactly **1** target `State`.

# Conceptual model description:
## Description
This model defines a simple state machine structure. A `StateMachine` (named) *contains* `State` and `Transition` elements (also named). Transitions are triggered by exactly one `TimeEvent` that specifies a positive time value. States are connected via transitions through source/target relationships, and a state machine may designate one start state.

### Components
- **`NamedElement` (abstract)**
  - `name : String` — common identifier for all named elements.

- **`State` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents a state.

- **`StateMachine` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents the container/owner of states and transitions.

- **`Transition` (extends `NamedElement`)**
  - No additional attributes; represents a directed connection between states.

- **`TimeEvent`**
  - `time : Integer` — time value used by a transition’s timer.

## Relationships
### 1) `StateMachineContainsStates` (composition)
- **StateMachine end:** `1`
  - Each `State` is owned by exactly **1** `StateMachine`.
- **State end:** `0..*` (role `containsStates`)
  - A `StateMachine` may contain **0 to many** `State` instances.

### 2) `StateMachineStartsStates` (association)
- **StateMachine end:** `0..1` (role `isStartStateOf`)
  - A `State` can be the start state of **at most 1** `StateMachine` (or none).
- **State end:** `1` (role `start`)
  - A `StateMachine` has **exactly 1** start `State`.

### 3) `StateMachineContainsTransitions` (composition)
- **StateMachine end:** `1`
  - Each `Transition` is owned by exactly **1** `StateMachine`.
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `containsTransitions`)
  - A `StateMachine` may contain **0 to many** `Transition` instances.

### 4) `TransitionContainsEvents` (composition)
- **Transition end:** `1`
  - Each `TimeEvent` is owned by exactly **1** `Transition`.
- **TimeEvent end:** `1` (role `timer`)
  - Each `Transition` has **exactly 1** `TimeEvent` timer.

### 5) `StateTransition` (association: State → outgoing Transitions)
- **State end:** `1` (role `source`)
  - Each `Transition` has exactly **1** source `State`.
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `outgoing`)
  - A `State` can have **0 to many** outgoing `Transition` instances.

### 6) `TransitionState` (association: Transitions → target State)
- **Transition end:** `0..*` (role `incoming`)
  - A `State` can have **0 to many** incoming `Transition` instances.
- **State end:** `1` (role `target`)
  - Each `Transition` has exactly **1** target `State`.

## Invariants
1. **`TimeEvent::TimeIsPositive`**
   - `self.time > 0`
   - Every `TimeEvent.time` must be strictly positive.

2. **`StateMachine::FirstCharLowerCase`**

## Instance (real-life plausible, but intentionally violates model multiplicities)

### Scenario
A **greenhouse irrigation controller in South Africa** waters plants **twice per day** (morning and evening). Engineers often model this as **one logical transition** from “idle” to “watering” that can be triggered by **either of two scheduled times**.

The model, however, forces each `Transition` to have **exactly one** `TimeEvent` timer. This makes “one transition with two schedules” impossible without awkward duplication.

---

## Elements

### StateMachine
- **StateMachine**
  - `name`: **"greenhouseIrrigationZA"**
  - `containsStates` (composition, owned): **idle, watering, draining, rainHold**
  - `containsTransitions` (composition, owned): **tStartWatering, tWateringToDraining, tDrainingToIdle, tIdleToRainHold, tRainHoldToIdle**
  - `start` (exactly 1 State): **idle**

---

### States (all owned by `greenhouseIrrigationZA`)
(Names start with lowercase, so the lowercase-name invariant is satisfied.)

1. **State**
   - `name`: **"idle"**
   - `outgoing`: **tStartWatering, tIdleToRainHold**
   - `incoming`: **tDrainingToIdle, tRainHoldToIdle**

2. **State**
   - `name`: **"watering"**
   - `outgoing`: **tWateringToDraining**
   - `incoming`: **tStartWatering**

3. **State**
   - `name`: **"draining"**
   - `outgoing`: **tDrainingToIdle**
   - `incoming`: **tWateringToDraining**

4. **State**
   - `name`: **"rainHold"**
   - `outgoing`: **tRainHoldToIdle**
   - `incoming`: **tIdleToRainHold**

---

### Transitions (all owned by `greenhouseIrrigationZA`)

1. **Transition**
   - `name`: **"tStartWatering"**
   - `source`: **idle**
   - `target`: **watering**
   - `timer`: **TWO TimeEvents** (both owned by this transition)
     - **TimeEvent A**: `time = 360` (minutes since midnight = 06:00)
     - **TimeEvent B**: `time = 1080` (minutes since midnight = 18:00)
   - Real intent: start watering at **06:00 or 18:00** using a single logical transition.

2. **Transition**
   - `name`: **"tWateringToDraining"**
   - `source`: **watering**
   - `target`: **draining**
   - `timer` (single TimeEvent):
     - `time`: **15** (minutes; watering duration)

3. **Transition**
   - `name`: **"tDrainingToIdle"**
   - `source`: **draining**
   - `target`: **idle**
   - `timer`:
     - `time`: **3** (minutes; allow lines to depressurize)

   - `target`: **rainHold**

   - `source`: **rainHold**
   - `target`: **idle**
   - `timer`:
     - `time`: **60** (minutes; re-evaluate conditions hourly)

### Violates `TransitionContainsEvents` multiplicity
- Model requires: **each Transition has exactly 1 TimeEvent** (`timer : 1`).
- In this realistic scheduling scenario, **`tStartWatering` has two timers** (06:00 and 18:00) because one logical transition is triggered by multiple scheduled times.
- This exposes the model as overly restrictive for common “multi-schedule” automation without forcing duplicate transitions or extra workaround states.

#### Shared timer object (intentional problem)

The model also includes basic reference types (Date, State, VehicleTypeCode) and constraints ensuring non-negative numeric values.

### Components

#### Data types and enums
- **Date (dataType)**
  - Constructor/operation: `Date(date : String)` to create a Date from a string.
- **State (enum)**
  - Allowed values: `AL, AK, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL`.
- **VehicleTypeCode (enum)**

  - `name : String` — office name.
  - `number : Integer` — office identifier/number.
  - `address : String` — office address.
- **Vehicle**
  - `id : Integer` — vehicle identifier.
  - `registrationState : State` — state of registration.
  - `licensePlateNumber : String` — plate number.
  - `vehicleTypeCode : VehicleTypeCode` — category/type code.
  - `registrationLastMaintenanceDate : Date` — last maintenance date.
  - `expirationDate : Date` — registration/inspection expiration date.
- **RentalAgreement**
  - `number : Integer` — agreement identifier/number.
  - `rentalDate : Date` — start date.
  - `anticipatedDuration : Integer` — expected duration (units not specified).
  - `depositPaid : Real` — deposit amount.
  - `quotedDailyRate : Real` — daily rate.
  - `quotedRatePerMile : Real` — mileage rate.
- **Truck** *(inherits from Vehicle)*
  - `odometerReading : Integer`
  - `gasTankCapacity : Real`
  - `workingRadio : Boolean`
  - `mileage : Integer`
- **Customer (abstract)**
  - `name : String`
  - `address : String`
  - `poorRisk : Boolean` — risk flag.
- **Individual** *(inherits from Customer)*
  - `homePhone : String`
  - `driverLicenseState : State`
  - `driverLicenseNumber : Integer`
  - `driverLicenseExpirationDate : Date`
- **Company** *(inherits from Customer)*
  - `idNumber : Integer`

All multiplicities are stated as **[min..max]**.

1. **RentalOfficeVehicle** (role on RentalOffice end: `homeOffice`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ Vehicle [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **Vehicle** is associated with **exactly 1** RentalOffice (its home office).
     - Each **RentalOffice** can have **0 or many** Vehicles.

2. **RentalOfficeRentalAgreementOrigin** (roles: `originatingRentalOffice`, `originatingAgreement`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ RentalAgreement [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** has **exactly 1** originating RentalOffice.
     - Each **RentalOffice** can originate **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

3. **RentalOfficeRentalAgreementDrop** (roles: `droppoffRentalOffice`, `dropoffAgreement`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ RentalAgreement [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** has **exactly 1** drop-off RentalOffice.
     - Each **RentalOffice** can be the drop-off location for **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

   - **RentalAgreement [0..*] ↔ Customer [1]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** is linked to **exactly 1** Customer.
     - Each **Customer** can have **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

## Invariants
Constraints that must always hold:

### Truck
- **positiveGasTankCapacity**: `gasTankCapacity >= 0`
- **positiveMileage**: `mileage >= 0`

### RentalAgreement
- **positiveDepositPaid**: `depositPaid >= 0`
- **positiveQuotedDailyRate**: `quotedDailyRate >= 0`
- **positiveQuotedRatePerMile**: `quotedRatePerMile >= 0`

# Conceptual model description:
## Description
The model **VehicleRental** describes a vehicle rental domain: rental offices manage vehicles and create rental agreements.   - `licensePlateNumber : String` — plate number.
  - `vehicleTypeCode : VehicleTypeCode` — category/type code.

  - `expirationDate : Date` — registration/inspection expiration date.
- **RentalAgreement**
  - `number : Integer` — agreement identifier/number.
  - `rentalDate : Date` — start date.
  - `anticipatedDuration : Integer` — expected duration (units not specified).
  - `depositPaid : Real` — deposit amount.
  - `quotedDailyRate : Real` — daily rate.
  - `quotedRatePerMile : Real` — mileage rate.
- **Truck** *(inherits from Vehicle)*
  - `odometerReading : Integer`
  - `gasTankCapacity : Real`
  - `workingRadio : Boolean`
  - `mileage : Integer`
- **Customer (abstract)**
  - `name : String`
  - `address : String`
  - `poorRisk : Boolean` — risk flag.
- **Individual** *(inherits from Customer)*
  - `homePhone : String`

  - `driverLicenseExpirationDate : Date`
- **Company** *(inherits from Customer)*

1. **RentalOfficeVehicle** (role on RentalOffice end: `homeOffice`)

   - Meaning:

     - Each **Vehicle** can appear in **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

attempts.prompt:
# Conceptual model description:
## Description
The model **VehicleRental** describes a vehicle rental domain: rental offices manage vehicles and create rental agreements. Customers (individuals or companies) sign rental agreements for specific vehicles. The model also includes basic reference types (Date, State, VehicleTypeCode) and constraints ensuring non-negative numeric values.

### Components

#### Data types and enums
- **Date (dataType)**
  - Constructor/operation: `Date(date : String)` to create a Date from a string.
- **State (enum)**
  - Allowed values: `AL, AK, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL`.
- **VehicleTypeCode (enum)**
  - Allowed values: `TRUCK, TRUCK24, TRUCK10, COVERED_TRAILER, OPEN_TRAILER`.

#### Classes
- **RentalOffice**
  - `name : String` — office name.
  - `number : Integer` — office identifier/number.
  - `address : String` — office address.
- **Vehicle**
  - `id : Integer` — vehicle identifier.
  - `registrationState : State` — state of registration.
  - `licensePlateNumber : String` — plate number.
  - `vehicleTypeCode : VehicleTypeCode` — category/type code.
  - `registrationLastMaintenanceDate : Date` — last maintenance date.
  - `expirationDate : Date` — registration/inspection expiration date.
- **RentalAgreement**
  - `number : Integer` — agreement identifier/number.
  - `rentalDate : Date` — start date.
  - `anticipatedDuration : Integer` — expected duration (units not specified).
  - `depositPaid : Real` — deposit amount.
  - `quotedDailyRate : Real` — daily rate.
  - `quotedRatePerMile : Real` — mileage rate.
- **Truck** *(inherits from Vehicle)*
  - `odometerReading : Integer`
  - `gasTankCapacity : Real`
  - `workingRadio : Boolean`
  - `mileage : Integer`
- **Customer (abstract)**
  - `name : String`
  - `address : String`
  - `poorRisk : Boolean` — risk flag.
- **Individual** *(inherits from Customer)*
  - `homePhone : String`
  - `driverLicenseState : State`
  - `driverLicenseNumber : Integer`
  - `driverLicenseExpirationDate : Date`
- **Company** *(inherits from Customer)*
  - `idNumber : Integer`

## Relationships
All multiplicities are stated as **[min..max]**.

1. **RentalOfficeVehicle** (role on RentalOffice end: `homeOffice`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ Vehicle [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **Vehicle** is associated with **exactly 1** RentalOffice (its home office).
     - Each **RentalOffice** can have **0 or many** Vehicles.

2. **RentalOfficeRentalAgreementOrigin** (roles: `originatingRentalOffice`, `originatingAgreement`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ RentalAgreement [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** has **exactly 1** originating RentalOffice.
     - Each **RentalOffice** can originate **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

3. **RentalOfficeRentalAgreementDrop** (roles: `droppoffRentalOffice`, `dropoffAgreement`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ RentalAgreement [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** has **exactly 1** drop-off RentalOffice.
     - Each **RentalOffice** can be the drop-off location for **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

4. **RentalAgreementVehicle**
   - **RentalAgreement [0..*] ↔ Vehicle [1]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** is linked to **exactly 1** Vehicle.
     - Each **Vehicle** can appear in **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

5. **RentalAgreementCustomer**
   - **RentalAgreement [0..*] ↔ Customer [1]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** is linked to **exactly 1** Customer.
     - Each **Customer** can have **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

## Invariants
Constraints that must always hold:

### Truck
- **positiveGasTankCapacity**: `gasTankCapacity >= 0`
- **positiveMileage**: `mileage >= 0`

### RentalAgreement
- **positiveDepositPaid**: `depositPaid >= 0`
- **positiveQuotedDailyRate**: `quotedDailyRate >= 0`
- **positiveQuotedRatePerMile**: `quotedRatePerMile >= 0`

# Category: Edge Instances
Create an edge case instance. This is an instance that behaves within but at the limit of the expected behavior. This instance must focus on a scenario that is unusual or unlikely in real life but possible according to the syntax and semantics of the model. In terms of semantics, take into account constraints, multiplicities, and uncommon combinations of relationships and attributes.

# Conceptual model description:
## Description
The model **VehicleRental** describes a vehicle rental domain: rental offices manage vehicles and create rental agreements. Customers (individuals or companies) sign rental agreements for specific vehicles. The model also includes basic reference types (Date, State, VehicleTypeCode) and constraints ensuring non-negative numeric values.

### Components

#### Data types and enums
- **Date (dataType)**
  - Constructor/operation: `Date(date : String)` to create a Date from a string.
- **State (enum)**
  - Allowed values: `AL, AK, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL`.
- **VehicleTypeCode (enum)**
  - Allowed values: `TRUCK, TRUCK24, TRUCK10, COVERED_TRAILER, OPEN_TRAILER`.

#### Classes
- **RentalOffice**
  - `name : String` — office name.
  - `number : Integer` — office identifier/number.
  - `address : String` — office address.
- **Vehicle**
  - `id : Integer` — vehicle identifier.
  - `registrationState : State` — state of registration.
  - `licensePlateNumber : String` — plate number.
  - `vehicleTypeCode : VehicleTypeCode` — category/type code.
  - `registrationLastMaintenanceDate : Date` — last maintenance date.
  - `expirationDate : Date` — registration/inspection expiration date.
- **RentalAgreement**
  - `number : Integer` — agreement identifier/number.
  - `rentalDate : Date` — start date.
  - `anticipatedDuration : Integer` — expected duration (units not specified).
  - `depositPaid : Real` — deposit amount.
  - `quotedDailyRate : Real` — daily rate.
  - `quotedRatePerMile : Real` — mileage rate.
- **Truck** *(inherits from Vehicle)*
  - `odometerReading : Integer`
  - `gasTankCapacity : Real`
  - `workingRadio : Boolean`
  - `mileage : Integer`
- **Customer (abstract)**
  - `name : String`
  - `address : String`
  - `poorRisk : Boolean` — risk flag.
- **Individual** *(inherits from Customer)*
  - `homePhone : String`
  - `driverLicenseState : State`
  - `driverLicenseNumber : Integer`
  - `driverLicenseExpirationDate : Date`
- **Company** *(inherits from Customer)*
  - `idNumber : Integer`

## Relationships
All multiplicities are stated as **[min..max]**.

1. **RentalOfficeVehicle** (role on RentalOffice end: `homeOffice`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ Vehicle [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **Vehicle** is associated with **exactly 1** RentalOffice (its home office).
     - Each **RentalOffice** can have **0 or many** Vehicles.

2. **RentalOfficeRentalAgreementOrigin** (roles: `originatingRentalOffice`, `originatingAgreement`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ RentalAgreement [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** has **exactly 1** originating RentalOffice.
     - Each **RentalOffice** can originate **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

3. **RentalOfficeRentalAgreementDrop** (roles: `droppoffRentalOffice`, `dropoffAgreement`)
   - **RentalOffice [1] ↔ RentalAgreement [0..*]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** has **exactly 1** drop-off RentalOffice.
     - Each **RentalOffice** can be the drop-off location for **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

4. **RentalAgreementVehicle**
   - **RentalAgreement [0..*] ↔ Vehicle [1]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** is linked to **exactly 1** Vehicle.
     - Each **Vehicle** can appear in **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

5. **RentalAgreementCustomer**
   - **RentalAgreement [0..*] ↔ Customer [1]**
   - Meaning:
     - Each **RentalAgreement** is linked to **exactly 1** Customer.
     - Each **Customer** can have **0 or many** RentalAgreements.

## Invariants
Constraints that must always hold:

### Truck
- **positiveGasTankCapacity**: `gasTankCapacity >= 0`
- **positiveMileage**: `mileage >= 0`

### RentalAgreement
- **positiveDepositPaid**: `depositPaid >= 0`
- **positiveQuotedDailyRate**: `quotedDailyRate >= 0`
- **positiveQuotedRatePerMile**: `quotedRatePerMile >= 0`

The **VideoClub** model represents a video rental domain. The model also defines basic validity constraints (invariants) on key attributes.

### Components

#### Data types and enums
- **Date (dataType)**
  - Constructor/operation: `Date(date : String)`
  - Purpose: represents a date value created from a string.

- **Genre (enum)**
  - Values: `Action`, `Comedy`
  - Purpose: categorizes a movie.

#### Classes
- **Client**
  - `clientId : Integer` — identifier for the client.
  - `isSuspended : Boolean` — whether the client is suspended.

- **Rental**
  - `date : Date` — the date of the rental.

- **Cassette**
  - `title : String` — cassette title.
  - `availableCopies : Integer` — number of copies currently available.

- **Movie** *(inherits from Cassette)*
  - `genre : Genre` — the movie genre.

- **Series** *(inherits from Cassette)*
  - `episode : Integer` — episode number.

- **Actor**
  - `name : String` — actor name.

### 1) `ClientRental`
Connects **Client** and **Rental**.
- **Client end**: `Client [1]` (role `assigned`)
  - Each **Rental** is associated with **exactly 1 Client**.
- **Rental end**: `Rental [*]` (role `gets`)
  - Each **Client** can have **0..* Rentals**.

- **Rental end**: `Rental [*]` (role `borrowed`)

# Conceptual model description:
## Description
The **VideoClub** model represents a video rental domain. It captures **clients** who make **rentals**, where each rental includes one or more **cassettes** (either **movies** or **series episodes**). Cassettes are linked to **actors**. The model also defines basic validity constraints (invariants) on key attributes.

### Components

#### Data types and enums
- **Date (dataType)**
  - Constructor/operation: `Date(date : String)`
  - Purpose: represents a date value created from a string.

- **Genre (enum)**
  - Values: `Action`, `Comedy`
  - Purpose: categorizes a movie.

#### Classes
- **Client**
  - `clientId : Integer` — identifier for the client.
  - `isSuspended : Boolean` — whether the client is suspended.

- **Rental**
  - `date : Date` — the date of the rental.

- **Cassette**
  - `title : String` — cassette title.
  - `availableCopies : Integer` — number of copies currently available.

- **Movie** *(inherits from Cassette)*
  - `genre : Genre` — the movie genre.

- **Series** *(inherits from Cassette)*
  - `episode : Integer` — episode number.

- **Actor**
  - `name : String` — actor name.

## Relationships

### 1) `ClientRental`
Connects **Client** and **Rental**.
- **Client end**: `Client [1]` (role `assigned`)
  - Each **Rental** is associated with **exactly 1 Client**.
- **Rental end**: `Rental [*]` (role `gets`)
  - Each **Client** can have **0..* Rentals**.

### 2) `RentalCassette`
Connects **Rental** and **Cassette**.
- **Rental end**: `Rental [*]` (role `borrowed`)
  - Each **Cassette** can be part of **0..* Rentals** (over time).
- **Cassette end**: `Cassette [1..*]` (role `borrows`)
  - Each **Rental** includes **at least 1 Cassette**, possibly many (**1..***).

### 3) `CassetteActor`
Connects **Cassette** and **Actor**.
- **Cassette end**: `Cassette [*]` (role `actsIn`)
  - Each **Actor** can be linked to **0..* Cassettes**.
- **Actor end**: `Actor [1..*]` (role `has`)
  - Each **Cassette** must be linked to **at least 1 Actor**, possibly many (**1..***).

### Inheritance (generalization)
- **Movie < Cassette** and **Series < Cassette**
  - Every **Movie** and **Series** is a **Cassette** and inherits `title` and `availableCopies`.

1) **Client IDs must be positive**
- Context: `Client`
- Invariant `positiveClientId`:
  - `self.clientId > 0`

2) **Available copies cannot be negative**
- Context: `Cassette`
- Invariant `postiveAvailableCopies`:
  - `self.availableCopies >= 0`

3) **Series episode must be positive**
- Context: `Series`
- Invariant `positiveEpisode`:
  - `self.episode > 0`

# Conceptual model description:
## Description
The **VideoClub** model represents a video rental domain. It captures **clients** who make **rentals**, where each rental includes one or more **cassettes** (either **movies** or **series episodes**). Cassettes are linked to **actors**. The model also defines basic validity constraints (invariants) on key attributes.

### Components

#### Data types and enums
- **Date (dataType)**
  - Constructor/operation: `Date(date : String)`
  - Purpose: represents a date value created from a string.

- **Genre (enum)**
  - Values: `Action`, `Comedy`
  - Purpose: categorizes a movie.

#### Classes
- **Client**
  - `clientId : Integer` — identifier for the client.
  - `isSuspended : Boolean` — whether the client is suspended.

- **Rental**
  - `date : Date` — the date of the rental.

- **Cassette**
  - `title : String` — cassette title.
  - `availableCopies : Integer` — number of copies currently available.

- **Movie** *(inherits from Cassette)*
  - `genre : Genre` — the movie genre.

- **Series** *(inherits from Cassette)*
  - `episode : Integer` — episode number.

- **Actor**
  - `name : String` — actor name.

## Relationships

### 1) `ClientRental`
Connects **Client** and **Rental**.
- **Client end**: `Client [1]` (role `assigned`)
  - Each **Rental** is associated with **exactly 1 Client**.
- **Rental end**: `Rental [*]` (role `gets`)
  - Each **Client** can have **0..* Rentals**.

### 2) `RentalCassette`
Connects **Rental** and **Cassette**.
- **Rental end**: `Rental [*]` (role `borrowed`)
  - Each **Cassette** can be part of **0..* Rentals** (over time).
- **Cassette end**: `Cassette [1..*]` (role `borrows`)
  - Each **Rental** includes **at least 1 Cassette**, possibly many (**1..***).

### 3) `CassetteActor`
Connects **Cassette** and **Actor**.
- **Cassette end**: `Cassette [*]` (role `actsIn`)
  - Each **Actor** can be linked to **0..* Cassettes**.
- **Actor end**: `Actor [1..*]` (role `has`)
  - Each **Cassette** must be linked to **at least 1 Actor**, possibly many (**1..***).

### Inheritance (generalization)
- **Movie < Cassette** and **Series < Cassette**
  - Every **Movie** and **Series** is a **Cassette** and inherits `title` and `availableCopies`.

## Invariants

1) **Client IDs must be positive**
- Context: `Client`
- Invariant `positiveClientId`:
  - `self.clientId > 0`

2) **Available copies cannot be negative**
- Context: `Cassette`
- Invariant `postiveAvailableCopies`:
  - `self.availableCopies >= 0`

3) **Series episode must be positive**
- Context: `Series`
- Invariant `positiveEpisode`:
  - `self.episode > 0`
